title: Injectivity of binary encoding
statement: Let $A$ be a type with an encoding $e:A\to\{0,1\}^*$ and a partial decoder $d:\{0,1\}^*\to A$. Suppose decoding an encoded object recovers it, so $d(e(a))=a$ for every $a\in A$, and every successfully decoded string is the encoding of its decoded object. Then $e$ is injective.
hypotheses_covered: Decoding each encoded object recovers that object
Every successfully decoded string is the encoding of its decoded object
